label: rust-slice1 single @ d6933714: median of 3 zero-drop full runs, every duration scenario capped at 20 000 req/s (--rate 20000)
method: scripts/bench-gateway.ts, gateway cpus 0-3, upstream 4-5, oha 6-7, 20 s scenarios after a 3 s warmup, OMNI_LOG_LEVEL=warn, release build (fat LTO, mimalloc v2). Each value is median/min/max over the three runs in `runs`. Every run had 0 rows missing, 0 pending and 0 writer drops in every scenario.

shedding.note: Not comparable with TS (rows were dropped); kept to show what the writer changes did. Rows: answered = responses the clients got, done/pending = request_logs rows in the scenario window, writerDrops = the gateway's own drop warnings in the window.
